Import a module in different ways and use it.

Supplied answer
import math
print(math.sqrt(16), math.pi, math.ceil(4.1), math.floor(4.9))
from math import sqrt, pow
print(sqrt(25), pow(2, 3))
import math as m # alias
print(m.factorial(5))
Note: import module keeps the namespace; from module import name brings it in directly.
